question:
Choose the appropriate antonym of the given word.
Gullibility
solution:
The correct answer is: **Skepticism**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Gullibility"** refers to a tendency to be easily deceived or tricked; it is the quality of being overly trusting or naive. (भोलेपन का गुण)
 
 
• **Example:** His gullibility made him an easy target for online scams.
 
 
• **"Skepticism"** refers to a questioning attitude or doubt toward something that is generally accepted or believed; it is the opposite of gullibility. (संशयवाद)
 
 
• **Example:** Her skepticism about the miracle cure saved her from buying an ineffective product.
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Gullibility'** is **'Skepticism'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Skepticism**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Trust **(विश्वास): Confidence in the reliability, truth, or ability of someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** She placed her trust in the team to complete the project successfully.
 
 
 
• **Naivety **(भोलेपन): Lack of experience, wisdom, or judgment; being overly innocent or simplistic.
 
 
• **Example:** His naivety led him to believe every word of the salesperson.
 
 
 
• **Innocence **(निर्दोषता): The state of being free from guilt, sin, or deceit; often associated with simplicity or purity.
 
 
• **Example:** The innocence of children is heartwarming and pure.
